name: CCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The record holds one reign, Ric Flair's, from 1995.

name: CCW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by 2 Cold Scorpio as of 15 November 1995; the title stands untouched when he loses a same-night non-title match to Shawn Michaels, and he is previewed defending it against Bret "Hitman" Hart at Survivor Series '95.

name: CCW United States Championship
epitaph: Held by Sting, who retains it on 15 November 1995 over Steve Richards under a loser-leaves-CCW stipulation, then is previewed defending it again against Hunter Hearst-Helmsley at Survivor Series '95.

name: CCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Public Enemy as of 15 November 1995, previewed defending it against Harlem Heat at that Sunday's Survivor Series '95 -- the held record's single surviving document never shows the Public Enemy in the ring.

name: CCW Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Raven, who retains it on 15 November 1995 against Razor Ramon after Ramon's own cornerman, the 123 Kid, turns on him mid-match.
